in_marathi.name: Anshi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ansh - Breath, soul, essence; I - Inner self
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anshi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anshi means 'inner soul', 'essence of life', or 'breath of life'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ansh' which means 'breath, soul, or essence' and 'I' which means 'inner self'. In Hinduism, the soul is considered to be the inner self that transcends the physical body and is the true essence of a person.
